summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, providing an update to a prior announcement regarding the further grant of awards under its 2021 and 2022 RSU schemes and the grant of options under its Post-IPO Share Option Scheme. The update clarifies that the annual general meeting date for the scheme mandate limit was May 19, 2025, not May 20, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer is involved; this is a routine equity compensation disclosure.
